_comment: GGUF manifest for the optional in-app downloader (GUI 'Download models...' / TUI 'm'). model_dir = the folder llama.cpp loads GGUFs from; it must hold the files named in config.ini (same basenames as below). repo_id values are '<owner>/<repo>' placeholders - fill them only if you want the downloader to fetch missing files from Hugging Face; if the files already exist in model_dir nothing else is needed. On a new machine change model_dir and run `python doctor.py --pipeline` to verify every file is present.
